title: Avoid this app - appears to be a scam now
body:
You may notice I posted a review in April to say this app was now charging for features that were previously free.
I paid the annual fee as I had 3 years worth of history I didn’t want to lose.
It’s now trying to charge again even though I have a subscription for another 7 months.
Appears to be a scam now. Avoid this app
author: del0017
